svg.title: The Claude app's Code tab: you ask for three agents, they appear in the band above the prompt box, finish one by one, and fold away.

g.text: Use three agents at once: plan a birthday party, build a shopping list, and review both.
On it. I'm starting three helpers so they all work at the same time.
Started architect: plan the birthday party
Started developer: build the shopping list
Started reviewer: review the plan and list
All three are done. Your party plan and shopping list are ready, and the review found one thing to fix.
Use three agents at once: plan a birthday party, build a shopping list, and review both.
